## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.

## Scope

Which area does this relate to?

- [ ] New backend template (e.g. Elixir Phoenix, Hono)
- [ ] New frontend template (e.g. Astro, Solid)
- [ ] New database support
- [ ] New CI/CD pipeline
- [ ] New DevOps tooling (e.g. Pulumi, Ansible)
- [ ] CLI improvements
- [ ] TUI/UI enhancements
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other
